invariants.CustomerPrivacy: Customer identity is merchant scoped. Receipt delivery never grants marketing consent.
invariants.HardwareSideEffect: A hardware command has stable identity. An unknown physical outcome is never retried blindly.
invariants.IdempotencyRetention: A command result replays for 72 hours, then returns IDEMPOTENCY_EXPIRED.
invariants.InventoryAtomicity: A stock-tracked sale and its inventory effects commit in one database transaction.
invariants.InventoryLedger: Every stock effect is an immutable ledger fact. A projection is never the sole authority.
invariants.InventoryRestockLimit: A restock cannot exceed the refunded quantity or the original stock consumption.
invariants.KitchenAuthority: A kitchen projection references one committed sale. A KDS command cannot change a financial fact.
invariants.KitchenEventOrder: A client applies only a newer aggregate version. It recovers a gap from the authoritative snapshot.
invariants.LoyaltyLedger: Every points effect is an immutable ledger fact. A projection is never the sole authority.
invariants.Money: minorUnits is an integer and currency is an uppercase ISO 4217 code.
invariants.OfflineCommandEnvelope: sequence is positive and fingerprint is a SHA-256 hexadecimal value.
invariants.PaymentAmbiguity: When status is unknown, queryOnly must be true and canRetryAsNew must be false.
invariants.PostSaleCompensation: Original sale facts stay immutable. Each exception creates linked append-only compensation facts.
invariants.RefundAmbiguity: An unknown terminal refund is query-only and blocks a replacement refund.
invariants.RefundLimit: Cumulative line, tax, discount, tip, tender, and cash compensation cannot exceed original facts.
invariants.StoredValueAtomicity: A stored-value debit and its committed sale are one database transaction.
